entries.selector: .ca-overlay (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, Drawer, Lightbox, CommandPalette, DocsSearch)
entries.replacement: dialog.ca-overlay::backdrop for the scrim; .ca-overlay is the <dialog> itself
entries.note: A modal is one native <dialog> moved to <body>, the scrim is its ::backdrop. CSS that targeted a separate overlay element or the old portal container no longer matches; a rule written for the old overlay now paints the panel.

entries.replacement: add bits-ui to your own dependencies if you import it
entries.note: bits-ui is no longer installed with the package, and `ssr.noExternal` for it is not needed.
Props, exported types, `ca-*` classes and `data-state` did not change; the `--bits-*` and `data-bits-*` hooks are gone.

entries.replacement: pass name to Select (4.0.0 renders a hidden input carrying the value)
entries.note: `required` still blocks native form submit; a form that read the old hidden input must pass `name` on Select.

entries.selector: setLocale(x) in the root layout of an SSR app
entries.note: `setLocale` is a no-op on the server (with a dev warning) because module state was shared across concurrent requests. The codemod only flags the call (file:line) since the layout markup has to be wrapped by hand; client-only apps keep `setLocale`.
`Locale` is a string now; a custom language is registered with a partial dictionary and falls back to English per key. `createErrorHandler()` takes `locale` for its fallback message.
